title: How the Dutch Police Clung to Predictive Policing for a Decade Without Evidence
text: The Crime Anticipation System was discontinued in early 2026 after a devastating internal report concluded that its 'predictive' capabilities were extremely limited. The police were never able to demonstrate that the algorithm had any measurable impact on reducing crime.
